motivation: Training-free ways to add capability found by the 2026-11-08 literature survey; ExPO needs only the public base and instruct checkpoints, and its result is one weight delta.
hypothesis: Some alpha in 0.1 to 0.5 raises E2B's MBPP+ test-half pass count against alpha = 0 (exact McNemar p < 0.05) and against a control edit of matched strength, and holds at FP8.

config.control: random direction per tensor, same Frobenius norm as alpha * delta, seed 87
config.gate: McNemar p < 0.05 on test at bf16, above control, not lower at FP8
